name: asaps-modern
description: Advanced Story Authoring and Presentation System - Modern Implementation
author: Hartmut Koenitz

scripts.prepare: npm run build:deps || echo 'Build skipped (CI or first install)'
scripts.build:deps: npm run generate:types && npm run build -w @asaps/core && npm run build -w @asaps/renderer && npm run build -w @asaps/player
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev -w @asaps/core" "npm run dev -w @asaps/builder" "npm run api:dev -w @asaps/builder"
scripts.build: npm run generate:types && npm run build -w @asaps/core && npm run build -w @asaps/renderer && npm run build -w @asaps/player && npm run build:player-web && npm run build -w @asaps/builder
scripts.build:player-web: npm run build -w @asaps/player-web && npx shx mkdir -p packages/builder/public && npx shx cp packages/player-web/dist/player-web.umd.js packages/builder/public/player-web.js && npx shx cp packages/player-web/dist/player-web.css packages/builder/public/player-web.css
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check -w @asaps/core && npm run type-check -w @asaps/renderer && npm run type-check -w @asaps/builder

_overridesComment: Security pins for transitive deps with no in-range parent fix.
